title: ReportIndexDocumentUpsertedPayload
description: report.index_document.upserted v1 (OpenVibe.Report server/search-index.js, via openvibe-publishing/search-feed). The OpenVibe.Search document of a Rundown topic page (type topic, /rundown/t/<slug>, the slug as the id): the topic's title, headline and summary of what streamers said about it, from OpenVibe.Live's Rundown. Live's own topic pages are noindex; Report's are the public copy. Sent by the sweep at boot and on a timer; a topic that left the Rundown becomes a tombstone. The sequencer (report_index_revisions) gives an unchanged document its old revision and nothing is sent. Always visibility public and publication_state published. Facets: kind, takes. Consumed by OpenVibe.Search ('*.index_document.*'). Envelope: subject { type, id, revision }, visibility internal, actor service:report.
